text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...A horse girl devoting all her love to 
the race, completely unbounded.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, so burning hot... so painful... 
It's crawling out... the thing inside me—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! ...Ah, n-no...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Haa... I can't... I must suppress... 
this ache...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk to catch my breath 
after work, I spotted a troubled Still in 
Love, and Sweep Tosho sneaking around 
trying to hide from her.
choice_data_list: What on earth are they doing...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The truth is... for a while now, it feels 
like I'm constantly being stalked? 
Watched? ...by her.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Even when I try to ask her why, she runs 
away. Though she does look like she wants 
to say something...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I'm at a loss. If I am causing her any 
trouble, I would like to make amends, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love looked troubled. It 
certainly would be bothering anyone. 
Wondering if there was a way to help, I 
suggested—
choice_data_list:
How about creating a setting where you can 
talk properly?
We just have to block her escape route!
Let's wait for her to tell you herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she looks like she wants to say 
something, how about preparing a proper 
setting for her? For example, somewhere 
quiet with no other people around...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I see... A place where she won't worry 
about prying eyes and can speak easily, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I will give it a try right away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? I lost sight of her again—...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please, don't run away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I-I'm not running away! Not 
really...! I just had something I wanted 
to ask you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Tell me the honest truth. You're troubled 
by something or having some big problem, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Why are you suddenly asking such a 
thing?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I saw you earlier at the training grounds 
looking like you were in so much pain. 
So... I know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're looking for "prey", aren't you? 
...You're feeling thirsty, right?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah...?! No way... To think you saw me 
in such a shameful state...?! Please... 
please forget you saw that...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't quite understand what the two of 
them were talking about, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While their conversation seemed to flow, 
there felt like a subtle disconnect 
somewhere. ...Was it just my imagination?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...It's okay. After all, I'm an 
exceptional witch. Besides, Grandma will 
lend us a hand too!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: S-Sweep-san?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait! That thirst of yours, I'm 
gonna cure it for you!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Eh, u-um...?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes. But...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... To think she saw me like that... 
What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Part of me wanted to know more about the 
situation, but seeing how embarrassed 
Still in Love looked, I decided against 
pressing further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After soothing the flustered Still in 
Love, we watched Sweep Tosho run off into 
the distance...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Is this really alright, cornering her like 
this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though somewhat hesitant, Still in Love 
steeled her resolve, and together we 
blocked Sweep Tosho's escape route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, we asked her the reason behind 
her stalking—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I-I was just... Still was...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, it's nothing! Forget it! I've 
figured out what's going on these past few 
days, and I can handle the rest by myself!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um, Sweep-san... If I have done something 
wrong to upset you, please let me know—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to say anything. 
...Especially when there are people around 
like this guy trying to expose secrets, 
it's dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Still. If you're thinking of making 
this guy your prey, don't do it. ...I'll 
figure something out for you!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Eh, prey?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I swear it on the name of the magical girl 
Sweepy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho thrust her finger high into 
the sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to follow what was happening, Still 
in Love and I both tilted our heads in 
confusion...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...That's true. She must have her reasons, 
so we shouldn't force it out of her.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I'll wait until she feels ready to tell 
me. Until then...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I must make sure... that she doesn't 
see the other "me"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love muttered softly under her 
breath, her eyes narrowing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For an instant, a shiver ran down my spine 
from her gaze. Giving a slight bow, Still 
in Love quietly left the scene...
